title: On Saint Stephen
author: Hesychius of Jerusalem
blurb: Hesychius of Jerusalem’s homily on Saint Stephen, the first martyr, in a fresh English translation from the Greek.
first_english_note: A fresh English translation of Hesychius of Jerusalem’s homily on Saint Stephen, made from the Greek text printed in PG 93. No modern English version was used for its wording.

text_history.method: A fresh English translation made from the Greek text printed in PG 93.
